name: Umbral-Shoal

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
